verdict.rationale: Recurly documents a public REST API with official client libraries in seven languages, mobile SDKs, webhooks for real-time events, and entitlement checks via API, giving AI-native users a documented programmatic surface to drive the product. missing for 10: independent hands-on developer corroboration of API robustness/completeness and a full public API reference (only client-library and feature docs are shown, not exhaustive endpoint docs).
